title: unwrap_or(0) comment inverts actual replay behavior
description: Line 244-246 of events.rs says unwrap_or(0) for server_n 'causes replay to proceed rather than silently suppressing it.' This is backwards. The guard is `if server_n <= lei_n { return None }`. With server_n=0 and any valid lei_n >= 0 (e.g. 's-0' gives lei_n=0, so 0 <= 0 is true), replay is suppressed, not triggered. The comment states the opposite of what the code does. A developer reading this comment to understand the fallback behavior will be misled about the invariant.
